Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-
Yojana (PM-MKSSY)
Aquaculture Financial Assistance Fisheries Insurance Loan Stakeholder
The "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)" is being
implemented by the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying,
Department of Fisheries, Government of India as the Central Sector Sub-Scheme
under the ongoing PMMSY for a period of four years in all the States and Union
Territories.
Objectives:
Gradual Formalisation of fisheries sector by creating work-based Identities for
fishers, fish farmers and other stakeholders under a National Fisheries Digital
Platform (NFDP).
Facilitating access to institutional finance.

Registration Process: Apply as an Individual/Organization
Step 01: Select New User Registration from the top menu or from the Apply
for Sub-scheme Benefits under PM-MKSSY section on the Home Page.
Step 02: Click Apply as an Individual/Organization button as per your Profile.
Step 03: Enter Aadhaar Number or Pan card Number. Check consent box, click
on 'Validate Aadhaar' button.
Step 04: Enter OTP received on Aadhaar linked mobile number. Click on
validate button. After successful validation next screen will ask for Mobile
number.
Step 05: Enter mobile number. Enter Captcha. Click on Next button.
Step 06: Enter OTP received on mobile number. Click on validate button. After
successful validation, the NFDP Registration form will open.
Step 07: Fill in the complete Registration details. as per your profile:
Personal/Organization Information, Address, Occupation & Bank Details &
submit.
Step 08: Note your NFDP Registration Number and download your Provisional
NFDP Registration certificate by clicking the Download Certificate button.
Login Process:
Beneficiary Login- https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/login
Credit Facilitation- https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/credit-facilitation
Aquaculture Insurance- https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/insurance
